IC1: Participants must present a diagnosis of osteoporosis [AND] based on DXA [AND] measurement of the bone mineral density [AND] at the femur neck [OR] and/or total hip [OR] and/or lumbar spine (T value 2.5 SD or more below the young female adult mean) within the past 24 months.
IC2: N[NOT] ot in treatment with anti-resorptive agents (like bisphosphonates  [OR]and denosumab) for more than 4 consecutive years, in order to reduce the risk of medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaws (Lo et al., 2010).
IC4: In self-reported menopause, defined as the permanent cessation of ovulation, for at least one year (Soules et al., 2001).
IC5: Edentulous area involving a maximum of two teeth (wisdom teeth and second molars are excluded) and presenting at least one neighbouring tooth (e.g. gap in the area of a second premolar and first molar, with first premolar in place).
IC6: Residual alveolar width = 4 mm (Milinkovic and Cordaro, 2014), residual alveolar height >8 mm, enough inter-arch space for a crown (at least 5 mm) and a minimum distance of 7 mm from the adjacent teeth (Shah and Lum, 2008). The width and height will be confirmed after x-ray examination in Visit 2.
IC7: Possibility to restore a functional occlusion with a minimum of four occlusal units (i.e. pairs of occluding posterior teeth).
IC8: Willingness to replace the missing tooth/teeth with dental implants
